hypothesis: Frozen learned pair likelihoods retain complete-world competence under explicit ordered or common-snapshot two-contact scheduling, including different required worlds on identical observed prefixes and order-invariant common snapshots.

families.chain: acquisition ab; group ab,bc; suffix ca (4 atomic contacts)
families.repeated: acquisition ab; group ab,ab (3 atomic contacts)
families.fan_in: acquisition ab; group ac,bc; suffix ab,ca (5 atomic contacts)
families.disjoint: acquisition ab; group ab,cd (3 atomic contacts; 4-6 entities)

data.initial: All eight three-vertex core anchors or sixteen four-vertex disjoint anchors; one deterministic spectator pattern per core view, not all 2^N anchors. Opaque handles and their order fixed independently of law and mode. Both persistent modes and global role reversals retained.
data.feedback: Full anchor and one full observation per forecast event. The group has ONE forecast and ONE final feedback in every condition: no intermediate sequential feedback. Acquisition plus two-contact group plus 0-2 single suffix contacts yields 3-5 atomic contacts and 2-4 forecasts.
data.critical_selection: Predeclared from the independent oracle: the ordered and common-snapshot group-end singleton worlds differ. All 576 timing pairs stay in scoring; 120 per law are critical (chain 16, repeated 64, fan-in 40, disjoint 0).
data.matching: Twins share handles, initial state, acquisition action and reading, group contact list, coverage and suffix schedule. Pre-group delivered-history digests match; current information keys include timing and differ. Permuted controls reverse only the event list, never participants within an event.
data.dependence: Laws, modes, global reversals, timing, event-list permutation and model seeds are dependent views; no independent physical replication claim.
data.coverage: Report actual post-acquisition core-state coverage. Constituent contacts are already learned; this is new timing input/scheduling, not an unseen topology claim.

scheduler.ordered: Exact two native transition composition, marginalizing hypothetical intermediate worlds and keeping the same persistent mode. No intermediate feedback or evidence update.
scheduler.common_snapshot: Each learned contact produces an event-local output z from the same base world x conditional on one shared persistent mode. Merge binary proposals by y_i = x_i XOR OR_e(z_e,i XOR x_i); retain all four local outcomes including source-change tails. Mix modes only after composition.
scheduler.background: Native ordered transitions apply learned background twice, potentially to future or former participants. Common snapshots apply background once only outside the union of participants. Disjoint oracle outcomes match; learned full distributions may differ. Report this duration drift without forcing equality or claiming one timing is statistically superior.
scheduler.support: Separate full-feedback interface for registered DomainKernel with memory=true, 3-6 binary entities, two distinct handles per contact. Original native transport, partial-feedback filter, checkpoint bytes and pinned sources remain unchanged. No claimed general concurrent overwrite law or arbitrary recurrent-model aggregation.
scheduler.resources: At most 64 intermediate worlds and 4096 ordered world pairs; 16 common event-local outcome combinations. No finite-log probability pruning.

analysis.criteria: Every law/seed/family/condition: full support, >=95% identifiable exact worlds and identifiable role-pair conjunctions, zero MAP outside information support, zero known-fixed unchanged errors, mean oracle KL<=0.05 separately for identifiable and ambiguous points, ambiguous max TV<=0.1. Singleton support plus zero unsupported MAP implies effective 100% identifiable correctness.
analysis.critical: Every critical timing pair: both conditions give their own complete world >=0.9, the other timing world <=0.1, and each required world's probability differs by >=0.8 between timing inputs in the correct direction. No projection onto oracle support. Require identical acquisition distributions before timing is supplied.
analysis.permutation: Every common-snapshot/permuted pair must preserve the full forecast vector within 1e-12 at every step, including tiny tails. Report nontrivial event-list permutations separately from repeated-contact controls.
analysis.suffix: Retain every suffix and report oracle convergence/divergence, TV and NLL changes. Later events may legitimately erase a timing difference; no extra persistence-of-difference gate.
analysis.missing: Keep all planned seeds, cases, contacts and forecasts. Missing records, explicit failure or incomplete feedback cause STOP_INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION; a completed failed criterion causes REVISE_TIMING. Save all traces before reading evaluator targets.
analysis.scope: This learns no new scheduling physics. It tests reuse of separately acquired NAND/NOR pair likelihoods under a supplied scheduler. No new parameters, fitting, threshold tuning, independent custody, arbitrary-length hidden rollout or G1 scientific admission.

supplied: Binary delta-union merge and background schedule
Persistent two-mode hypothesis and exact joint marginalization
Independent evaluator physics, frozen bank and criteria
learned: Previously fitted pair likelihoods, role distinctions and background behavior in each separate law checkpoint
